## Cleaning: NHANES 1999

```{r, ECHO=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

attach(data_nhanes_1999)

#creating new data frame which only has the variables of interest
df_nhanes_1999 <- data.frame(
  id_study = 'NHANES_1999_2000',
  id       = SEQN,
  
  psu1     = as.numeric(SDMVPSU),
  psu2     = NA,
  
  stratum1 = as.numeric(SDMVSTRA),
  stratum2 = NA,

  psu_weight1 = NA,
  psu_weight2 = NA,
  psu_weight3 = NA,
  
  # demographics
  sex     = DMDHRGND, #RIAGENDR
  age     = as.numeric(RIDAGEYR),
  race    = RIDRETH1,
  edu_adult = DMDEDUC2,
  edu_years = NA,
  edu_child = DMDEDUC3,
  ethnicity = RIDRETH2,
  
  #diabetes
  self_db      = DIQ010,
  age_told_db  = DIQ040Q,
  drug_insu_db = DIQ050,
  drug_pill_db = DIQ070,
  family_hx_db = NA,
  
  #labs
  fasting_minutes = as.numeric(PHAFSTMN),
  fasting_hours   = as.numeric(PHAFSTHR),
  fasting_8h      = NA,
  fasting_12h     = NA,
  fglu         = as.numeric(LBXGLU), units_fglu  = 'mg/dL',
  hba1c        = as.numeric(LBXGH), units_hba1c = '%',
  pogtt          = NA, units_pogtt   = NA,
  insulin      = as.numeric(LBXIN), units_insulin = 'uU/mL',
  
  creatinine_urine = as.numeric(URXUCR), creatinine_urine_units = 'mg/dL',
  
  total_cholesterol        = as.numeric(LBXTC), units_cholesterol = 'mg/dL',
  ldl                      = as.numeric(LBDLDL), units_ldl = 'mg/dL',
  
  #tb
  tb_history = TBQ040,
  age_told_tb  = NA,
  tb_treatment = TBQ050,
  tb_skin_test = TBQ010,
  tb_skin_test_result = TBQ020,
  tb_medication_use = TBQ030,
  
  # Measurements
  weight                   = as.numeric(BMXWT), units_weight = 'kg',
  height                   = as.numeric(BMXHT), units_height = 'cm',
  bmi                      = as.numeric(BMXBMI), units_bmi = 'KG/M**2',
  waist                    = as.numeric(BMXWAIST), units_waist = 'cm',            # just 1 measure
  hip                      = NA, units_hip = NA,                                 
  # These will be converted into blood_pressure_sys and blood_pressure_diast later
  blood_pressure_sys2       = as.numeric(BPXSY2), units_sbp = 'mmHg',
  blood_pressure_sys3       = as.numeric(BPXSY3), units_sbp = 'mmHg',
  blood_pressure_diast2     = as.numeric(BPXDI2),
  blood_pressure_diast3     = as.numeric(BPXDI3)
)

detach(data_nhanes_1999)
```

# Re-coding both datasets

```{r nhanes recode, ECHO=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

recode_nhanes <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(

      # sex
      sex = case_when(
        sex == 1 ~ 1, #men
        sex == 2 ~ 2, #women
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),

      # yes/no variables
      across(
        c(self_db, drug_insu_db, drug_pill_db,
          tb_history, tb_treatment, tb_medication_use,
          tb_skin_test, tb_skin_test_result),
        ~ case_when(
          . == 1 ~ 1,
          . == 2 ~ 0,
          . %in% c(7, 9) ~ 9,
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
      ),

      # family history
      family_hx_db = case_when(
        family_hx_db == 10 ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),

      # race
      race = case_when(
        race == 4 ~ 0,
        race == 3 ~ 1,
        race %in% c(1, 2) ~ 2,
        race == 5 ~ 3,
        race == 8 ~ 9,                # DK
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),

      # ethnicity
      ethnicity = case_when(
        ethnicity %in% c(1, 2, 4) ~ 1,
        ethnicity %in% c(3, 5) ~ 2,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),

      # education
      edu_adult = case_when(
        edu_adult %in% c(1, 2) ~ 1,
        edu_adult == 3 ~ 2,
        edu_adult == 4 ~ 3,
        edu_adult == 5 ~ 4,
        edu_adult %in% c(7, 9) ~ 9,
        TRUE ~ 9
      )

    )
}

# Re coding both datasets (1999 and 2011)
df_nhanes_2011 <- recode_nhanes(df_nhanes_2011)
df_nhanes_1999 <- recode_nhanes(df_nhanes_1999)

```

```{r data transf, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Cleaning fasting glucose:

    )

# Cleaning diabetes-lab variables:

library(dplyr)

df_nhanes_2011 <- df_nhanes_2011 %>%
  mutate(
    fglu  = ifelse(fglu  >= 36 & fglu  <= 540, fglu,  NA),      # Plausible range: 36 - 540 mg/dl
    hba1c = ifelse(hba1c >= 3  & hba1c <= 18,  hba1c, NA)       # Plausible range: 3 - 18 %
  )

df_nhanes_1999 <- df_nhanes_1999 %>%
  mutate(
    fglu  = ifelse(fglu  >= 36 & fglu  <= 540, fglu,  NA),      # Plausible range: 36 - 540 mg/dl
    hba1c = ifelse(hba1c >= 3  & hba1c <= 18,  hba1c, NA)       # Plausible range: 3 - 18 %
  )



# Diabetes: Self reported / labs (fasting glucose, HbA1c, oral glucose tolerance test)
create_self_lab_dm <- function(dm) {
  dm %>%
    mutate(
      self_lab_dm = case_when(
        self_db == 1 | fglu >= 126 | hba1c >= 6.5 | pogtt >= 200 ~ 1,
        !is.na(self_db) | !is.na(fglu) | !is.na(hba1c) | !is.na(pogtt) ~ 0,
        is.na(self_db) & is.na(fglu) & is.na(hba1c) & is.na(pogtt) ~ NA_real_
      )
    )
}

df_nhanes_1999 <- create_self_lab_dm(df_nhanes_1999)
df_nhanes_2011 <- create_self_lab_dm(df_nhanes_2011)

```

# Generating same SBP and DBP as other datasets
```{r blood pressure, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}

# Average of blood pressure measurement (systolic and diastolic #2 + #3 / 2)
process_bp <- function(df) {
  df$blood_pressure_sys   <- (df$blood_pressure_sys2 + df$blood_pressure_sys3) / 2
  df$blood_pressure_diast <- (df$blood_pressure_diast2 + df$blood_pressure_diast3) / 2
  
  df <- subset(df, select = -c(blood_pressure_sys2,
                               blood_pressure_sys3,
                               blood_pressure_diast2,
                               blood_pressure_diast3))
  return(df)
}

df_nhanes_1999 <- process_bp(df_nhanes_1999)
df_nhanes_2011 <- process_bp(df_nhanes_2011)
```

# Labeling both datasets
```{r labeling, ECHO=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
label_nhanes <- function(label) {
  label %>%
    mutate(
      # Sex
      sex = factor(sex,
                   levels = c(1, 2),
                   labels = c("Men", "Women")),

      # TB variables
      tb_history = factor(tb_history,
                          levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                          labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),
      tb_treatment = factor(tb_treatment,
                            levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                            labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),
      tb_skin_test = factor(tb_skin_test,
                            levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                            labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),
      tb_skin_test_result = factor(tb_skin_test_result,
                                   levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                                   labels = c("Positive", "Negative", "Refused/DK")),
      tb_medication_use = factor(tb_medication_use,
                                 levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                                 labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),

      # Diabetes self-report + labs
      self_db = factor(self_db,
                       levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                       labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),
      drug_insu_db = factor(drug_insu_db,
                            levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                            labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),
      drug_pill_db = factor(drug_pill_db,
                            levels = c(1, 0, 9),
                            labels = c("Yes", "No", "Refused/DK")),
      self_lab_dm = factor(self_lab_dm,
                           levels = c(1, 0),
                           labels = c("Diabetes", "No Diabetes")),

      # Family history
      family_hx_db = factor(family_hx_db,
                            levels = c(1, 0),
                            labels = c("Yes", "No")),

      # Race/Ethnicity
      race = factor(race,
                    levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 9),
                    labels = c("Non-Hispanic Black", 
                               "Non-Hispanic White", 
                               "Mexican/Other Hispanic", 
                               "Other/Multiracial", 
                               "Missing")),
      ethnicity = factor(ethnicity,
                         levels = c(1, 2, 9),
                         labels = c("Non-Hispanic", "Hispanic", "Missing")),

      # Education
      edu_adult = factor(edu_adult,
                         levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 9),
                         labels = c("< High School", 
                                    "High School Grad", 
                                    "Some College/AA", 
                                    "College+", 
                                    "Refused/DK"))
    )
}

df_nhanes_1999 <- label_nhanes(df_nhanes_1999)
df_nhanes_2011 <- label_nhanes(df_nhanes_2011)

```

```{r dm_tb, ECHO = FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hide'}
# For 1999
df_nhanes_1999 <- df_nhanes_1999 %>%
  mutate(
    tb_dm = case_when(
      self_lab_dm == "Diabetes" & tb_history == "Yes" ~ 1,  # both DM and TB
      TRUE ~ 0                                               # everything else
    )
  )

# For 2011
df_nhanes_2011 <- df_nhanes_2011 %>%
  mutate(
    tb_dm = case_when(
      self_lab_dm == "Diabetes" & tb_history == "Yes" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )

# Labeling both datasets
label_tb_dm <- function(tb_dm) {
  tb_dm %>%
    mutate(
      # diabetes & tuberculosis
      tb_dm = factor(tb_dm,
                   levels = c(0, 1),
                   labels = c("No", "Yes"))
    )
}

df_nhanes_1999 <- label_tb_dm(df_nhanes_1999)
df_nhanes_2011 <- label_tb_dm(df_nhanes_2011)

#Checking
table(df_nhanes_1999$tb_dm)
table(df_nhanes_2011$tb_dm)
```

```{r, labeling-variables-data, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(labelled)

# Create a named list of variable labels
nhanes_var_labels <- list(
  age = "Age",                        
  sex = "Sex",
  race = "Race",
  ethnicity = "Ethnicity",
```

```{r, NHANES TABLE (1999), message=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
library(gtsummary)

# Select the variables you want to include
vars_to_summarize <- c(
  "age", "sex", "race", "self_db", "age_told_db", "drug_insu_db", "drug_pill_db",
  "self_lab_dm", "family_hx_db",
  "tb_history", "age_told_tb", "tb_treatment", "fasting_minutes", "fglu", "hba1c", "total_cholesterol", "ldl", "weight", "height", "bmi",  "waist", "hip", "blood_pressure_sys", "blood_pressure_diast", "tb_dm")

# Create table1
NHANES_1999_table <- df_nhanes_1999 %>%
  select(all_of(vars_to_summarize), tb_dm) %>%  # include the grouping variable
  tbl_summary(
    by = tb_dm,  # group by TB+DM
    type = list(
      age ~ "continuous",
      age_told_db ~ "continuous",
      age_told_tb ~ "continuous",
      fglu ~ "continuous",
      hba1c ~ "continuous",
      fasting_minutes ~ "continuous",
      total_cholesterol ~ "continuous",
      ldl ~ "continuous",
      weight ~ "continuous",
      height ~ "continuous",
      bmi ~ "continuous",
      waist ~ "continuous",
      hip ~ "continuous",
      blood_pressure_sys ~ "continuous",
      blood_pressure_diast ~ "continuous"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} / {N} ({p}%)"
    ),
    label = var_label(df_nhanes_1999),
    missing = "no"
  ) 

NHANES_1999_table <- NHANES_1999_table %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Variables**") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(c(stat_1, stat_2) ~ "**Summary Statistics (NHANES 1999)**")

NHANES_1999_table

```
